data.one_liner: Send data and work with USB printers on Android.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to interact with USB printers on Android. It provides methods to list connected USB devices, connect to them, and write raw or text data for printing.
use_when: You need to connect and print receipts or documents to a USB thermal printer from an Android Flutter app.
You want to manage USB device permissions and bulk data transfers directly.
avoid_when: You need printing support for iOS, desktop, or web platforms.
You require high-level document printing (like PDF rendering) rather than raw ESC/POS byte streams.
strengths: Supports chunked data transfers and connection serialization for stable printing.
Handles automatic USB permission dialogs and detached device cleanups.
weaknesses: Documentation outside the basic README example is sparse.
data.setup_notes: Android only. Minimum SDK raised to 24 in recent versions. Uses USB device attached intent-filters.
